summary: Collective Mining filed a 6-K describing metallurgical test results for the Apollo deposit at its Guayabales Project in Caldas, Colombia, disclosed via press release dated September 21, 2026. The filing reports recoveries — 95% gold, 92% silver, 85% copper on a master composite; 95% copper and 90% gold for the copper sub-domain; up to 74% tungsten with a 95% scheelite concentrate — supporting an integrated dual-route flowsheet with doré, copper and tungsten concentrate streams ahead of a planned 2027 Colombian licensing submission. No deal, stake, price or board recommendation is referenced; this is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
